Dr. Mario.name: Dr. Mario
Dr. Mario.summary: Dr. Mario is a falling block tile-matching video game, in which Mario assumes the role of a doctor, dropping two-colored medical capsules into a medicine bottle representing the playing field.

Rewind Time.name: Rewind Time
Rewind Time.summary: Rewind Time is a puzzle game where you can go back in time. All moved objects return to their original location after using that power. Once a chest is placed in the right place, it will no longer be affected by time. You can't rewind time when you are standing on the original location of a chest (so you have to memorize the location of all the chests).

Sushi Gun.name: Sushi Gun
Sushi Gun.summary: A small Game Boy game about sushi & cats made in GB Studio!
